dedupe_keys.name: infrastructures du reseau de telecommunication tres haut debit inolia sur le territoire de bordeaux metropole

description: Infrastructures du réseau de télécommunication très haut débit Inolia sur le territoire de Bordeaux Métropole is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com. Bordeaux Métropole has set up a very high-speed telecommunications network called Inolia. This dataset represents by a linear the infrastructures of the Inolia network. For each section: the number of ducts present, their owner, their fibre-optic capacity, the length of the section and the municipality on which the infrastructure is installed. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Infrastructure of the Inolia high-speed telecommunications network on the territory of Bordeaux Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire, fibres, opendata, télecom, données ouvertes, infrastructures. The listing shows 2006-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
